name: Tim Dooley Atlas Backend Registry
purpose: Machine-readable registry for the canonical atlas data layer. The atlas-manifest is the human-facing map; this registry is the health and endpoint layer beneath it.
policy: Relationship-first. Architecture, records, research evidence, country data, potato research, emotion/state and lore remain separate internally but are addressable through one atlas. Entanglement is structured relation metadata, not automatically quantum physics.

countryLayer.remainingResearchQueue: open — macroeconomic country observations must be loaded and validated before a country counts as empirically enriched
countryLayer.status: Overlay existence is no longer treated as evidence. Only validated observations with provenance count toward empirical enrichment.

evidenceLayer.status: Active; global religion observations are loaded with provenance, while country macro indicators remain explicitly researched_missing until cached observations are validated.

entanglementLayer.model: Structured relations carry coupling, dependency, correlation, distance, directionality, temporal order, path dependence, feedback, topology, trajectory, phase and counterfactual sensitivity where appropriate.
entanglementLayer.quantumGuardrail: Quantum entanglement is a physical concept and must not be inferred merely from network correlation or symbolic relation.
entanglementLayer.fateGuardrail: Fate and destiny are interpretive models unless independently evidenced.

emotionLayer.guardrail: Hawkins levels are not Hertz measurements; symbolic colour is not electromagnetic frequency.

potatoLayer.status: Active; material, spatial, historical-symbolic and Potatoism-defined layers are separated.
potatoLayer.epistemicRule: Project-defined symbols such as Jesus Door are not empirical claims. Physical geometry and measurements must be sourced or calculated.

graphLayer.status: Evidence-derived edges are kept separate from project-defined symbolic relationships and can be traced to observation IDs.
graphLayer.entanglementExtension: Relationship records may be annotated with entanglement metadata without changing their underlying evidence class.
